kurz: Too much heat: the proteins contract and squeeze out water. The scrambled egg is then dry and watery at the same time.
bild_im_kopf: Like an orange in a press: the harder you squeeze, the more juice ends up next to the egg on the plate.

ursachen.warum: Above about 80 °C the proteins contract strongly and squeeze out liquid.
fix: Take off the heat while it still looks too wet

ursachen.warum: The egg keeps cooking in the hot pan.
fix: Put it on the plate straight away

ursachen.warum: Tomatoes, mushrooms or salt added early draw out water.
